display_long_description:
The highest-rated VR shooter is FREE. VAIL delivers precision-crafted gunplay, 10+ competitive modes, and a massive free Extraction island. 
Customize your gear, squad up, and see why VAIL has 4.8 stars across 67K reviews.

[media]


#  **TRAINING GROUNDS (FREE-TO-PLAY)**
Jump in with nothing. Random maps, weapon pickups, and loadout modifiers designed to get you into real gunfights fast. To know what VAIL's gunplay actually feels like in your hands.

[media]
[media]

#  **EXTRACTION (FREE EARLY ACCESS)**
Descend into the depths of Reyn. Extract encrypted data, technology, and resources while autonomous drones guard every corridor like archangels. A free, high-stakes mode that rewards patience, precision, and knowing when to run.

[media]
[media]


#  **SOCIAL HUB (FREE-TO-PLAY)**
VAIL's Social Hub is the center of gravity. Hang out, shoot, Challenge players to 1v1s, or mine ORE shards from the quarry to unlock rewards.

[media]



#  **VAIL COMBAT (UNLOCKABLE)**

This is what VAIL was built for. Team Deathmatch, Seek and Destroy, Free for All, and 10+ more modes. Full progression, 8 prestiges, leaderboards, stats, competitive, and the complete weapon and cosmetics system. Upgrade once, play forever.

[media]
[media]



# **CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED**
VR Game of the Year Finalist - VR Awards 2022 / People's Voice: Best VR Game - Webby Awards 2024 / Best Social/Interactive - VRDB Community Choice Awards 2024
Voted by the community. Verified by 67,000+ reviews. 4.8 stars on the Quest store.

[media]

Join the community!
Discord.gg/VAILVR

[media]
